title: 第八章：香火反噬
content_zh:
陆沉舟的到来，让七村百姓本能后退。

    天债院在南荒，是比官府更可怕的存在。

    官府只能抓人。

    天债院能定债。

    一个人一旦被定为恶意逃债，活着要被锁魂，死后不得入籍，连祖坟都可能被查封。

    所以即便许还山已经拿出证据，许多人还是怕。

    陆沉舟正是看准了这一点。

    他抬手展开银簿。

    “灵雨神君为天债院敕封正神，香火债经南荒分司核验。许还山私藏神契，勾连妖物，伪造证据。按律，收押。”

    黑衣债官上前。

    姜照雪撑伞挡住。

    陆沉舟看见她，神色微动。

    “姜照雪，你果然在这里。”

    姜照雪冷声道：“陆沉舟，十年前南荒分司第七号试验，是你批的？”

    陆沉舟面不改色。

    “我不知你在说什么。”

    许还山笑道：“不知道没关系，我帮你回忆。”

    他拨动算盘。

    半空中浮出那行被他从井底撕出来的账文。

    群体寿债试验，南荒分司第七号。

    陆沉舟眼底终于闪过一丝寒意。

    但他很快恢复平静。

    “伪造院账，罪加一等。”

    许还山看着他。

    “你说伪造就伪造？”

    陆沉舟淡淡道：“我为南荒分司司祭，我说是伪造，便是伪造。”

    台下百姓一阵骚动。

    许还山沉默片刻，忽然叹了口气。

    “你们这些当官的，有时候比神明还方便。”

    陆沉舟冷声道：“拿下。”

    黑衣债官同时出手。

    姜照雪伞光一开，拦下三人。

    许还山则抬手拍向自己胸口。

    三百七十二枚血手印亮起。

    “槐水村赵二。”

    魂影浮现。

    “槐水村李氏。”

    魂影浮现。

    “槐水村周老七。”

    一个又一个亡魂出现在木台周围。

    他们没有攻击。

    只是站在那里。

    七村百姓看见熟悉的脸，哭声顿时炸开。

    “爹！”

    “娘！”

    “二哥！”

    陆沉舟脸色一沉。

    “亡魂不得扰世！”

    他抬手祭出一张金色镇魂符。

    符光压下，亡魂立刻开始变淡。

    许还山吐出一口血，却仍然站着。

    “陆司祭，你急着压他们，是怕死人说话？”
content_en:
The arrival of Lu Chenzhou made the people of the Seven Villages instinctively retreat.

    Tianyiyuan is a more terrifying existence than the government in Southern Wasteland.

    The government can only arrest people.

    The Heavenly Debt Court can settle debts.

    Once a person is convicted of maliciously evading debts, his soul will be locked up while he is still alive, he will not be allowed to become a citizen after his death, and even his ancestral graves may be sealed.

    So even though Xu Huanshan has produced evidence, many people are still afraid.

    Lu Chenzhou saw exactly this.

    He raised his hand and unfolded the silver book.

    "The Lord Lingyu was granted the title of Righteous God by the Heavenly Debt Court, and the incense debt was verified by the Nanhuang Branch. Xu Huanshan secretly hid the divine deed, linked it to monsters, and forged evidence. According to the law, he will be detained."

    The debtor in black stepped forward.

    Jiang Zhaoxue held up an umbrella to block it.

    Lu Chenzhou's expression moved slightly when he saw her.

    "Jiang Zhaoxue, you are indeed here."

    Jiang Zhaoxue said coldly: "Lu Chenzhou, were you the one who approved the No. 7 test of the Southern Wilderness Branch ten years ago?"

    Lu Chenzhou's expression did not change.

    "I don't know what you're talking about."

    Xu Huanshan smiled and said, "It doesn't matter if you don't know. I'll help you remember."

    He moved the abacus.

    The line of accounts he tore out from the bottom of the well appeared in mid-air.

    Group Life Debt Experiment, Nanhuang Branch No. 7.

    A chill finally flashed across Lu Chenzhou's eyes.

    But he quickly regained his composure.

    "Forgery of hospital accounts will be punished with an additional penalty."

    Xu Huanshan looked at him.

    "You said forgery means forgery?"

    Lu Chenzhou said calmly: "I am the chief priest of the Southern Wilderness branch. If I say it is forged, it is a forgery."

    There was a commotion among the people in the audience.

    Xu Huanshan was silent for a moment and suddenly sighed.

    "You officials are sometimes more convenient than gods."

    Lu Chenzhou said coldly: "Take it."

    The debtors in black took action at the same time.

    Jiang Zhaoxue opened her umbrella and stopped the three of them.

    Xu Huanshan raised his hand and patted his chest.

    Three hundred and seventy-two bloody handprints lit up.

    "Zhao Er of Huaishui Village."

    The shadow of the soul emerges.

    "The Li family in Huaishui Village."

    The shadow of the soul emerges.

    "Zhou Laoqi from Huaishui Village."

    One dead soul after another appeared around the wooden platform.

    They didn't attack.

    Just stand there.

    When the people of the seven villages saw a familiar face, they burst into tears.

    "Dad!"

    "Mother!"

    "Second brother!"

    Lu Chenzhou's face darkened.

    "The souls of the dead must not disturb the world!"

    He raised his hand and held out a golden Soul Calming Talisman.

    When the talisman light was pressed down, the soul of the dead immediately began to fade.

    Xu Huanshan spit out a mouthful of blood, but still stood.

    "Priest Lu, are you in a hurry to suppress them because you are afraid that the dead will talk?"
